verification_scope: Official source metadata, GEO series-matrix headers and selected count-file headers were read live; this catalog is not an expression analysis or a clinical validation result.

access_classifications.open_structure: Public coordinates and metadata; no authentication required.
access_classifications.open_sequence: Public sequence and annotation; no authentication required.
access_classifications.open_omics: Public sample metadata and processed omics; raw availability is recorded separately.
access_classifications.public_processed_only: Processed omics are public; raw sequencing reads are not supplied because of consent limitations.
access_classifications.aggregate_only: Trial registry and aggregate results are public; participant-level data are not supplied by the registry.
access_classifications.registry_only: Trial protocol metadata are public; this record currently has no posted registry results.
access_classifications.open_spatial_large: Open spatial transcriptomics and images, with large per-patient archives; metadata is small and separately downloadable.
access_classifications.public_processed_controlled_raw: Processed single-cell object is public; human raw sequencing files require a controlled-access application.

global_limitations: No verified dataset links all requested diseases, individual structures, drug exposure, serial CRP, blood and urine measurements.
Reference structures are not patient-specific and cannot be joined to GEO participants by patient ID.
Psoriasis skin data are not a psoriatic arthritis joint cohort.
Lupus nephritis is cataloged separately and must not be described as an adalimumab treatment cohort.
Metadata inspection does not certify data quality, causal treatment effects, predictive performance or publication novelty.
Third-party data and publications retain their own licenses independently of this repository.

recommended_primary_design.research_question: Describe the experimentally observed TNF-adalimumab Fab interface and test paired changes in prespecified TNF-related expression signatures after adalimumab in psoriasis skin.
recommended_primary_design.response_analysis: Exploratory only: GSE85034 has 14 ADA baseline-lesional/week-16 pairs and a small response-labeled subgroup derived from PASI.
recommended_primary_design.validation_limit: GSE74697 supports independent before/after expression validation but has no inspected public PASI/response labels.

exploratory_TOP2A_RA_extension.question: Is within-cell-type TOP2A expression associated with RA inflammatory/proliferative state and does it change after adalimumab, independently of changes in cell composition?
exploratory_TOP2A_RA_extension.analysis_readiness: Metadata/feature feasibility established; actual spatial and Seurat expression import and QC are pending.
minimum_controls: proliferation and cell-cycle signatures excluding TOP2A itself
exploratory_TOP2A_RA_extension.binding_claim: No direct TNF-TOP2A or adalimumab-TOP2A binding claim is supported by these datasets.

datasets.title: Crystal structure of TNFalpha in complex with Adalimumab Fab fragment

biological_assembly.description: One TNF chain, one Fab light chain and one Fab heavy chain; does not contain the complete TNF trimer plus three Fab fragments.

limitations: Fab only; Fc and the complete therapeutic IgG are absent.
Interface contacts from the deposited three chains do not include all inter-subunit contacts from crystal symmetry neighbors.
A physiological trimer-Fab rendering requires an explicitly documented derived symmetry assembly.
Reference experimental coordinates do not provide patient-level treatment-response labels.

datasets.title: The structure of tumor necrosis factor-alpha at 2.6 angstroms resolution. Implications for receptor binding
limitations: Missing modeled residues and resolution differ from 3WD5; align comparable residues and report the alignment.
A bound/unbound coordinate difference is not by itself proof of a causal drug-induced conformational change.

datasets.title: Shrinking the Psoriasis assessment gap: Early gene-expression profiling accurately predicts response to long-term treatment

license.name: GEO public access; submitter rights may apply

limitations: 14 ADA pairs are a small exploratory cohort; longitudinal arrays are not independent participants.
Non-lesional skin is from psoriasis participants and is not an independent healthy-control cohort.
ADA Subject27 week2 is labeled WK2; normalization of this known spelling variant must be recorded.
MTX Subject28 has anomalous WK 1NL/WK 1LS labels; resolve against primary study before interpreting as baseline.
No inspected public serum CRP, urine, drug trough concentration or anti-drug antibody values.
The deposited matrix was quantile-normalized using lumiN; record platform probe annotation and avoid unjustified repeated normalization.

datasets.title: Long non-coding RNAs in psoriatic and healthy skin

pairing.evidence: 18 matching HuMPreN/HuMPostN sample-title suffixes; explicit participant-id field not present in inspected header

license.name: GEO public access; submitter rights may apply

limitations: Does not provide inspected public PASI/response labels; suitable for expression-change validation, not response-prediction validation.
FPKM values are not raw gene counts and must not be supplied to a raw-count model.
Confirm pairing against primary study before the final statistical analysis.
Skin transcriptomics do not provide patient protein structures or routine serum/urine laboratory tests.

datasets.title: Multi-omics and Machine Learning Accurately Predicts Clinical Response to Adalimumab and Etanercept Therapy in Patients with Rheumatoid Arthritis [RNA-Seq]

license.name: GEO public access; submitter rights may apply

limitations: All RNA samples precede treatment; response at month6 is an outcome label, not a post-treatment RNA sample.
Cell types from one participant are dependent; split model validation by participant.
Raw counts file includes a sequencing-ID row immediately after the column header; do not parse it as a gene.
Public normalized matrices exclude several samples; catalog sample_count is deposited library count rather than the final analyzed sample size.
alcoholuseunitsweek is populated by stopped/never/yes; preserve and flag the apparent mislabeled field rather than guessing its meaning.
Verify units of blood-cell counts before clinical comparisons.
No inspected public serum CRP, urine, drug trough concentration or anti-drug antibody values.

top2a_feature.analysis_scope: baseline expression only; no treatment-change estimate

datasets.title: RNA-sequencing of whole blood samples from biologic naive rheumatoid arthritis patients initiating anti-TNF treatment

limitations: Mixed infliximab/adalimumab cohort; inspected series-matrix header has no participant-level drug field.

Raw reads are withheld, not verified as available through a controlled-access service.
Only 52 of 76 participants have both public timepoints.

datasets.title: Molecular characterization of kidney compartments from serial biopsies to differentiate treatment responders from non-responders in lupus nephritis
datasets.tissue: laser-microdissected kidney glomerular and tubulointerstitial compartments

pairing.source: GEO Overall_design; compartment-level pairs, not total independent participant count

license.name: GEO public access; submitter rights may apply

limitations: Not evidence for treating lupus with adalimumab.
181 records include compartments, controls and technical replicates; do not report 181 independent patients.
Compartment-wise pairing counts are reported by depositor and the complete participant-pair mapping is not yet audited.
Immune gene panel is targeted, not whole-transcriptome RNA-seq.
Do not pool kidney and psoriasis skin expression as comparable participant observations.
Urine protein metadata do not establish public raw urine ELISA or urinalysis datasets.

datasets.title: A single-cell RNA-seq dataset of synovial fluid from rheumatoid arthritis treated with TNF-alpha/JAK inhibitor

pairing.id_source: RA_<patient>_1 and RA_<patient>_2 sample titles with matching age/sex and explicit post-treatment drug

response_labels.availability: absent_from_inspected_series_matrix_header; clinical supplementary tables require further inspection

top2a_feature.reason: Public processed RDS is about 2.3 GiB; no full RDS/raw sequencing download performed.

limitations: Only five ADA participant pairs; cells are not independent treatment replicates.
All participants are female and also receive stable MTX; generalization and attribution to ADA alone are limited.
Published article says 100387 cells after QC, while GEO summary says 106506; audit processed object rather than treating these as identical.
Fibroblasts are sparse and mainly from one donor according to the primary article; this is a weak cohort for patient-replicated fibroblast-specific TOP2A inference.
RNA detection and changes in cycling-cell fraction require separate analyses; treatment effects need patient-by-cell-type pseudobulk.
Raw FASTQ files require controlled access; public processed-data availability is not an approval for raw data.

limitations: Only six ADA participants; patient-level replication remains small even with many segmented cells.
TOP2A is in the stated base assay panel, but detected patient-level expression and adequate cycling fibroblast counts must be verified before selecting this as the primary TOP2A analysis.

5k spatial measurement is a targeted panel, not whole-transcriptome sequencing.
